questions.question: For the week spanning November 8 through November 14, 2020, how many cases of Chlamydia were reported in Oregon?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('or_weekly_reportable_diseases.csv')
filtered = df[(df['FirstDateOfWeek'] == '2020-11-08') & (df['Disease'] == 'Chlamydia') & (df['Place_name'] == 'Oregon')]
result = int(filtered['Cases'].iloc[0])

questions.question: Which condition had more reported cases in Oregon during the week of November 15 to November 21, 2020: Gonorrhea or Salmonellosis?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('or_weekly_reportable_diseases.csv')
subset = df[(df['FirstDateOfWeek'] == '2020-11-15') & (df['Disease'].isin(['Gonorrhea', 'Salmonellosis']))]
result = str(subset.sort_values('Cases', ascending=False).iloc[0]['Disease'])

questions.question: Did Oregon report any cases of Congenital syphilis for the surveillance week ending November 7, 2020?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('or_weekly_reportable_diseases.csv')
cases = df[(df['LastDateOfWeek'] == '2020-11-07') & (df['Disease'] == 'Congenital syphilis')]['Cases'].iloc[0]
result = 'yes' if cases > 0 else 'no'
